name: The Queendom of Lithzena
source: You wake up in a land dominated by monster girls and dominatrixes. Explore dungeons, customize your character, and fight with hot girls. Will you escape a world full of mean, sexy women, or would you prefer to remain as a pet forever?
translation: 你在一片由怪物女孩和施虐狂统治的土地上醒来。探索地下城，定制你的角色，并与辣妹战斗。你会逃离这个充满卑鄙、性感女人的世界，还是愿意永远作为宠物？
